card-flick.author: Kenney Vleugels (kenney.nl)
card-flick.role: dry single-card flick/shove transient for card play, stamp and shuffle layers
card-flick.note: License verified on pack page ('License: CC0') and in the zip's License.txt ('Creative Commons Zero, CC0'). Chose card-shove-1 (0.77s, crest 24.6) over card-place/card-slide variants: a single dry flick with no room ambience.

paper-slap.author: Luckius
paper-slap.role: transient-heavy paper impact for page turns, dossier slams and UI paper layers
paper-slap.note: License verified on OGA page: 'License(s): CC0' (field-art-licenses), icon links to creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Picked paper_sound_-_3 (crest 24, discrete sharp impacts) over the -1/-2/-4 rustles.

metal-clang.author: Kenney Vleugels (kenney.nl)
metal-clang.role: resonant metal strike with real ring-out for clash, shieldbreak and trick impacts
metal-clang.note: License verified on pack page and zip License.txt (CC0). impactBell_heavy_001 (1.74s) has a full ring-out decay; impactMetal_* files are dry 0.17s hits with no ring.

glass-shatter.author: TinyWorlds
glass-shatter.role: glass breaking with debris tail; pitched up + trimmed to fragments in shieldbreak/clash-loser recipes
glass-shatter.note: License verified on OGA page: 'License(s): CC0'. 1.31s: initial burst plus scattered debris tail. Raw peaks above full scale, so normalisation keeps loudnorm true-peak limiting (TP=-2).

wood-hit.author: Kenney Vleugels (kenney.nl)
wood-hit.role: solid wood-on-wood impact for table thuds, wood chop and card-land weight layers
wood-hit.note: License verified on pack page and zip License.txt (CC0). impactPlank_medium_000 (0.78s): immediate attack, solid body — not a hollow-door knock.

rope-creak.author: Department64 (cleaned/normalised upload by AntumDeluge)
rope-creak.role: fibre-under-tension creak for Ward binds, rope tension and strain cues
rope-creak.note: License verified on OGA page: 'License(s): CC0'. No CC0 rope-specific recording was found on OGA/Kenney; a tree-trunk creaking under wind tension is the closest CC0 match to rope/fibre strain, which the task brief permits. Trimmed to the active 0.15-4.2s region; the remainder of the 6.58s file is near-silence.

fire-crackle.author: PagDev
fire-crackle.role: sustained loopable fire crackle bed (>=3s) for Eclipse/fire trick layers
fire-crackle.note: License verified on OGA page: 'License(s): CC0' (dcterms.creator PagDev). 29.26s wood-fire loop with a steady envelope and no wind/ambience dominance; normalisation keeps an 8s mid-file segment (2-10s). The other CC0 candidate (opengameart.org/content/fire-crackling, fire-1.wav) was rejected at 2.87s (<3s floor).
